blocks.label: Maker Voice
blocks.body: GOLDWATER RECALL ASSURANCE: Why carry an unregistered stone when you could lease ours, with quarterly recall fees and a Recall Recall Clause?

blocks.label: At The Table
blocks.body: Set a trigger: proximity, damage in very close range, elapsed time, or spoken keyword. On trigger it teleports to the owner's hand.
